evidence.section: Post-transcriptional Gene Regulation of the Immune Response to Vaccination
evidence.quote: To assess whether or not miRNAs contribute to the differences in response we saw between young and elderly vaccinees, we measured the miRNA expression profiles of 672 human miRNAs on days 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination from a subset of subjects in the 2010 cohort ( Figure 7A ).
